run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T07:34:23Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy (firing since 2026-11-17T07:34:23Z) matches a real, sharp rise in frontend-proxy's own error spans: its STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate was ~0/s before 07:34 and then 0.6/s at 07:35 and roughly 1.8-2.3/s through 07:47, on the ingress and router frontend egress operations carrying HTTP 500. The failing path visible in traces is checkout PlaceOrder -> shipping /get-quote -> shipping's client span "POST quote" erroring with otel.status_description "Timeout" after ~5.00s, which makes checkout return gRPC 13 INTERNAL and frontend /api/checkout return 500 to frontend-proxy. Starting 07:34:17 (6 seconds before the alert) the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition began creating a NetworkChaos object every minute (last observed spawn 07:43:17), and each experiment's Applied events name exactly otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv; shipping's quote calls started timing out in the same minutes while quote and email emitted no error spans and all otel-demo pods stayed Running/ready with 0 restarts. The chaos Schedule is the supported root-cause object, but the conclusion is partial: the chaos CustomResource spec (action, mode, direction, loss/delay, duration) is not readable with the available tools, the RequestErrorRate rule expression could not be retrieved, and events are the only direct evidence for the chaos objects.

claims.text: frontend-proxy emitted STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans during the incident: at 2026-11-17T07:45:00Z its span rate was 0.975/s ERROR versus 19.858/s UNSET, split across span_name "ingress" (0.490/s ERROR, 9.925/s UNSET) and "router frontend egress" (0.485/s ERROR, 9.932/s UNSET).

The frontend-proxy error signal deviated at the alert start: a 1-minute error rate was 0 at 07:27-07:34 apart from isolated 0.03-0.1/s spikes, then 0.6/s at 07:35 and 1.77-2.33/s from 07:36 to 07:47; a 5-minute view shows the same onset (0.078/s at 07:35, 0.526/s at 07:37, 0.974/s at 07:39, peaking 1.222/s at 07:41).

Sampled frontend-proxy error spans are HTTP 500s on the checkout path: ingress and router frontend egress spans carry error=true, http.status_code=500, otel.status_code=ERROR, with frontend "POST /api/checkout" 500 and frontend client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder rpc.grpc.status_code=13 whose message is "13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500"; one sampled pair instead shows ingress 503 with router-egress http.status_code=0.

Trace 57075df3f14f46a92d8ea1cf5a6dbdd0 shows the failing dependency: checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder is ERROR (rpc 13) under checkout span "HTTP POST" ERROR, whose child shipping span "/get-quote" is ERROR with otel.status_description "Internal Server Error", whose child shipping client span "POST quote" is ERROR with otel.status_description "Timeout" and duration 5,001,029us; no quote server span appears for that request.

The same failure signature recurs across traces in the sampled error evidence: shipping "POST quote" spans with otel.status_description "Timeout" of ~5.00-5.001s and shipping "/get-quote" spans with "Internal Server Error" appear in traces 55b38e983dff6258783e727af2b0bb25, d72b746a7b5e69a0406b2d55dc5d62c3, 57075df3f14f46a92d8ea1cf5a6dbdd0, 80bf99d59268a9f1e08b40a2de669157, cfdf4d5ad0a694a5b21b34e15dc11411, c1a658dbcd21def84df159bb012e2df0 and b17a7c935dc387d3906ccba4f3241a15.

shipping's own client calls to quote changed at the same time: the shipping span_name "POST quote" STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate had no points before 07:35, was 0.333/s at 07:36 and 0.67-0.76/s through 07:48, while its UNSET rate fell from ~0.78-0.93/s before 07:35 to ~0.06-0.16/s afterwards.

quote and email did not show error status in their own spans at 07:45: every returned series for service_name="quote" (calculate-quote, {closure}, POST /getquote) and service_name="email" (send_email, sinatra.render_template, POST /send_order_confirmation) was STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and quote was still serving ~0.098/s per operation; shipping and checkout were the only services in that set with STATUS_CODE_ERROR series (shipping "POST quote" 0.481/s, " /get-quote" 0.481/s, checkout "HTTP POST" 0.535/s, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 0.535/s).

The chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition spawned a NetworkChaos object every minute from 07:34:17 to 07:43:17 (Spawned/Updated events), each experiment reporting Started and then TimeUp/Recovered about 55s later; each experiment's Applied events name otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv only.

PodNetworkChaos events in namespace otel-demo cover exactly the two affected pods, quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv, at 07:34:17-07:43:17 (38 Updated events), and both pods carry app.kubernetes.io/name labels quote and shipping respectively.

The affected pods themselves stayed up: all 21 otel-demo pods were Running with ready containers, restartCount 0 and empty lastState, including frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-wvxht, quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w, shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv, checkout-5dccddf8bb-pd7qk and email-59f69bc6cf-8z5c5, and no Evicted, OOMKilling, Unhealthy, BackOff or FailedScheduling events exist in namespace otel-demo (the only such events in the cluster are for data-recorders recorder pods).

Service-level error spans at 07:45 concentrate on the checkout path: frontend 1.925/s, checkout 1.070/s, shipping 0.963/s and frontend-proxy 0.975/s ERROR spans, while payment and accounting returned explicit 0 and ad/fraud-detection/recommendation returned only ~0.0017-0.0018/s.

The otel-demo ConfigMap flagd-config (key demo.flagd.json) defines no quote or shipping failure flag and sets every flag's defaultVariant to off, including emailMemoryLeak (off) and paymentUnreachable/paymentFailure (off).

The network chaos that chaos-mesh applied to the quote and shipping pods is the mechanism behind the observed shipping->quote 5s timeouts: shipping's client span "POST quote" timed out while quote emitted no error spans and its inbound rate dropped to ~0.098/s, i.e. most requests from shipping never completed at quote; the fault's exact action/mode/loss parameters are not readable, so this is a mechanism hypothesis, not an observed spec.

The Schedule name otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition does not match the pods the experiments were applied to (quote and shipping), while the observed timeout path is shipping->quote; the naming/fault intent therefore does not match the observed blast radius, and the selector that produced this targeting is unknown because the chaos objects' specs cannot be read.

quote and email were not shown to be failing on their own: quote's spans were all STATUS_CODE_UNSET with no error status and it still served ~0.098/s, email's spans were likewise all UNSET, so the frontend-proxy 500s are not explained by quote or email returning application errors.

Pod-level failure of frontend-proxy (crash, restart, OOM or eviction) as the cause is rejected: frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-wvxht was Running and ready with restartCount 0 and no lastState termination, and namespace otel-demo had no Evicted/OOMKilling/Unhealthy/BackOff/FailedScheduling events during the window.

A flagd feature-flag fault (the mechanism used for adFailure/paymentFailure/cartFailure etc.) is not supported as this cause: flagd-config declares no quote or shipping failure flag and all default variants are off, and the observed failure is a transport-level 5s timeout on shipping's call to quote rather than an application-level flagged error; runtime flag overrides at incident time could not be verified.

Validate the chaos experiment with its owners: inspect (read-only) the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition and the NetworkChaos objects it spawned (e.g. otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition-5czjs, spawned 07:43:17 with no observed TimeUp/Recovered in the window) to confirm selector, direction, loss/delay and duration, and pause/expire the schedule if the shipping/quote impact is unintended.

Separately verify the RequestErrorRate alert definition, because the reported current value 0.6444 does not match the span-error share observed for frontend-proxy (0.490/s ERROR over 0.490+9.925/s spans, about 4.7%), and the rule named RequestErrorRate could not be retrieved from Prometheus.

gaps: chaos-mesh CustomResources cannot be read with the available kinds, so the Schedule/NetworkChaos specs (action, mode, selector, direction, loss/delay, duration) and the Schedule's current existence are unknown; the root-cause identification rests on events.

The RequestErrorRate alerting rule was not returned (list_prometheus_rules rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned nothing), so the expression behind the reported 0.6444 value is unknown; that query returned no data and cannot be cited as proof the rule does not exist.

Email pod logs were not obtained (fetch_pod_logs for email-59f69bc6cf-8z5c5 read 0 lines), so the email service's runtime behaviour at the time could not be verified; the same applies to shipping, quote and checkout log filters, which matched no lines (status no_data, not citable).

The checkout exception text mentions "failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500" while the trace evidence shows shipping's call to quote timing out and no email error spans; the discrepancy in that application-generated message could not be resolved from the available evidence.

http_server_request_duration_seconds_count for frontend-proxy returned no series, so HTTP status-code level request/error ratios for frontend-proxy are unknown; the no-data answer to the NetworkPolicy query also cannot prove absence of NetworkPolicies.
Chaos-mesh events returned begin at 07:34:17, so whether any earlier chaos experiment existed in the window is unknown (events may have expired).

FailedScheduling (07:17-07:18) and Killing (07:21) events on data-recorders pods jaeger-traces-recorder-0, prometheus-alert-recorder-0 and clickhouse-unified-recorder-8bfdd99cb-mvltl were observed but are outside the otel-demo request path and were not investigated as part of this cause.
No ERROR metric series existed for quote, email, cart, currency, product-catalog, kafka or image-provider in the service-level error query; for those services this is unknown rather than proven zero.
next_steps: Ask the chaos/platform owners whether the otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition Schedule was intended and what selector/targets it declares, since it applied chaos to quote and shipping pods despite its email-checkout name.
Check the recording/alert rule definition behind RequestErrorRate to confirm which metric and denominator produce the 0.6444 value, and whether that ratio is the intended signal for frontend-proxy.

If the shipping->quote impact needs independent confirmation beyond events, capture NetworkChaos/PodNetworkChaos object state (kubectl get networkchaos,schedule -n chaos-mesh -o yaml) while an experiment is active.
